4.18 Chart · Composition

Design System
Chart/Pictogram
Isotype: a count shown as repeated icons — “3 in 10” is felt, not calculated. Compare stacks rows per group or period. 2 variants.
Overview
What it is and when to reach for it.
3 in 10
students finish the first course within a month
1 icon = 5% of students
When to use
Make a share tangible for a broad audience — reports, social posts, landing pages.
Small whole numbers (“3 in 10”, “1 in 4”).
Compare two periods or groups row by row.

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
10, 20 or 100 icons — the reader should count fast.
One icon shape per chart; meaning, not decoration.
Always show the unit and the exact number in text.
Icons wrap; never squash or stretch them.
Felt, not calculated
Use when the audience must feel the share. For precise comparison of many groups use Bar.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Isotype: a count shown as repeated icons — “3 in 10” is felt, not calculated. Compare stacks rows per group or period.
Encoding
icon count = total units; filled icons = value (rounded, last icon may be partial); colour = on/off; rows = groups.
Interaction
Hover → tooltip; optional fill-in animation on first view.
Accessibility
role="img" + text value (“3 in 10 students”); icons aria-hidden; reduced motion respected.
Component
<Pictogram value={0.3} total={20} unit="students" icon="person" rows={[{ label, value }]} />
